data.one_liner: Dart SDK for Clerk authentication and user management.
data.what_it_does: Provides sign‑up, sign‑in, session handling and user profile management through Clerk's API. Includes session‑token polling and support for passkeys and organization data. Works across Android, iOS, macOS, Windows and Linux.
use_when: You need Clerk as your authentication backend
You want a single package handling sign‑in, sign‑up and session token streams
You require cross‑platform support without native SDKs
avoid_when: You need a stable, production‑ready SDK (still beta)
You prefer official provider SDKs like Firebase or Google Sign‑In
Your app only needs simple local biometrics
strengths: Supports passkeys, session token streaming and organization metadata
Works on all major desktop and mobile platforms
data.setup_notes: Add publishable key in AuthConfig, choose a Persistor (e.g., DefaultPersistor) and ensure a cache directory is provided for the platform.

alternatives.name: firebase_auth
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official, stable Firebase authentication with broad community support
